summary: NovaBridge Biosciences furnished a Form 6-K reporting that majority-owned ophthalmology subsidiary Visara, Inc. entered an exclusive license agreement with Wuhan Hiteck Biological Pharma for VIS-102 (HT006.2.2), an investigational modified recombinant human nerve growth factor therapy for neurotrophic keratitis. Terrain is worldwide excluding Greater China. Visara owes a $7.0 million upfront and near-term milestone plus up to $104.0 million in clinical and commercial milestones, and tiered single-digit percentage royalties on annual net sales. A six-member joint steering committee governs development and commercialization. The filing is a routine in-license disclosure, not a special situation.
